items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Well, the girl, was that Mamie?

ctx.x: So the father in talking to Oscar, told him, he says, "When I die," he says, "I'm going to will everything to you, 'cause I know you'll take care of my daughter." And this father had parking lots all over Los Angeles proper. Oscar Moore hasn't touched a guitar since. No one knows where he is or how he can be found.
Well, the girl, was that Mamie?
I don't know who she was.
